findings.location: translation.html — paragraph 3 ("Lente mag haar deel soggende...")
findings.source_quote: Spring may have its equal share of soggy and uncomfortable appointments and ragged days.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace 'soggende' with a more natural Afrikaans term such as 'soggy' → 'sog' or 'nat' (e.g. "Lente mag haar deel nat en ongemaklike dae hê...") to improve idiomatic clarity while preserving meaning.
findings.translation_quote: Lente mag haar deel soggende en ongemaklike dae hê en geskeurde oomblikke.

findings.source_quote: Summer can be unbearable with its burning heat and humidity,
findings.suggested_fix: Use the more common Afrikaans 'vogtheid' rather than 'humiditeit' for natural idiom: e.g. "...brandende hitte en vogtheid..."
findings.translation_quote: Somer kan ondraaglik wees met sy brandende hitte en humiditeit, maar dit dra ’n skynbare seën...

findings.location: translation.html — paragraph (Versterking) ("Diegene wat hulleself aan alle kante sal isoleer...")
findings.source_quote: Those who will insulate themselves on every side from the buffeting of winter will, no doubt, incur a weakening of the will.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the typographic/wording error 'hulleself' to 'hulle hulself' or restructure to 'hulle sal hulself' for grammatical correctness. Suggested: "Diegene wat hulself aan alle kante sal isoleer teen die storm van die winter sal ongetwyfeld ’n verswakking van die wil ervaar."
findings.translation_quote: Diegene wat hulleself aan alle kante sal isoleer teen die storm van die winter sal ongetwyfeld ’n verswakking van die wil ervaar.

findings.location: translation.html — paragraph (Saamwees) ("met een gees in Salomo se voorhof")
findings.source_quote: with one accord in Solomon’s porch (Acts 5:12)
findings.suggested_fix: Consider the slightly more standard Afrikaans rendering 'in een gees' instead of 'met een gees' for smoothness in this biblical phrase: e.g. "in een gees in Salomo se voorhof". This is stylistic and optional; current wording is acceptable theologically and accurate.
findings.translation_quote: met een gees in Salomo se voorhof (Handelinge 5:12).
